```{r setup, echo=TRUE, include =FALSE}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
```

```{r Procssed extracted data, include=FALSE}
extracted_data <- read.csv("Data/extracted_data/final_processed_cholera_climate_systematic_review_extract_into_sheets.csv")
```

```{r Shapefiles, include=FALSE}
## Location shapefiles ----
total_shps <- readRDS("Data/shapefiles/location_shapefiles.rds")
## Country shapefiles ----
country_shps <- readRDS("Data/shapefiles/country_shapefiles.rds")
```

```{r Plotting functions,include=FALSE}
# Spatial distribution ----
# Function to plot the shapefiles with spatial distribution of extracted data
plot_shapefiles_spatial <- function(extracted_data, total_shps, country_shps) {
  # Merge extracted_data with shapefiles using the 'lctn_pr' column
  merged_data <- dplyr::left_join(total_shps, extracted_data %>% distinct(lctn_pr,eff_admin), by = "lctn_pr") %>% 
    mutate(
      eff_admin = factor(eff_admin,levels = c("non-adm geography", "adm0", "adm1", "adm2", "adm3")),
       admin_alpha = ifelse(
      eff_admin == "non-adm geography", 0.2,
      ifelse(
        eff_admin == "adm0", 0.4, 
        ifelse(
          eff_admin == "adm1", 0.6,
          ifelse(
            eff_admin == "adm2", 0.8,1
          )
        )
      )
    )
)

colors_admin_levels <- function(){RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n=5,name = 'Blues')}

p<-ggplot(data = merged_data %>% mutate(admin_alpha = as.numeric(admin_alpha))) +
     geom_sf(aes(fill = eff_admin), color = "black") + # Single layer with fill by eff_admin
     # Set fill colors
     scale_fill_manual(values = colors_admin_levels(), name = "Admin Level") + 
     ggplot2::geom_sf(data = country_shps, fill = NA, alpha = 0) + 
     # Additional plot aesthetics
     theme_bw() +
     theme(legend.position = "right") +
     labs(title = "Spatial Distribution of Extracted Data")

  # Save the plot
  ggplot2::ggsave("Analysis/Figures/spatial distribution.png", plot = p)
  
  print(p)
  return(NULL)
}

# Function to plot shapefiles filled by number of papers/estimates
plot_shapefiles_by_paper_est_count <- function(extracted_data, total_shps, country_shps) {
  
  library(dplyr)
  # Count the number of papers/estimates per location
  location_count <- dplyr::group_by(extracted_data, lctn_pr, eff_admin) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(est_count = dplyr::n(),
                     paper_count = length(unique(studykey)))
  
  # Merge extracted_data with shapefiles using the 'lctn_pr' column
  merged_data <- dplyr::left_join(total_shps, location_count, by = "lctn_pr") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
      est_count_cat = ifelse(est_count>2,"<=2 estimates",">2 estimates"),
      paper_count_cat = ifelse(paper_count>1,"1 paper",">1 papers")
    )
  
  # Plot shapefiles filled by the number of papers/estimates
  p1 <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data = merged_data, ggplot2::aes(fill = paper_count_cat), color = "black",alpha = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data = country_shps, fill = NA, alpha = 0) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("skyblue","orange")) + 
    ggplot2::theme_bw() + 
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~eff_admin) + 
    ggplot2::ggtitle("Shapefiles: Fill by Number of Papers")
  
  p2 <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data = merged_data, ggplot2::aes(fill = est_count_cat), color = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data = country_shps, fill = NA, alpha = 0) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("skyblue","orange")) + 
    ggplot2::theme_bw() + 
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~eff_admin) + 
    ggplot2::ggtitle("Shapefiles: Fill by Number of Estimates")
  
  # Save the plot
  ggplot2::ggsave("Analysis/Figures/shapefiles_by_paper_count.png", plot = p1, width = 10, height=8,dpi = 300)
  ggplot2::ggsave("Analysis/Figures/shapefiles_by_est_count.png", plot = p2, width = 10, height=8,dpi = 300)
  
  print(p1)
  print(p2)
  return(NULL)
}

# Function to plot number of spatial locations by country
plot_histogram_location <- function(extracted_data, filter){
  # Group all composite locations into one country group
  if(filter == "country_cat"){
  extracted_data <- extracted_data %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
      country_cat = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(eff_country,"\\||multi"), " multicountry", eff_country)
    )
  }

  # Summarize number of papers/estimates per country
  loc_count_country <- dplyr::group_by(extracted_data, !!sym(filter)) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(unique_loc_count = length(unique(lctn_pr)))
  
    # Plot histogram of the number of papers/estimates per country/continent
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = loc_count_country) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(ggplot2::aes(x = !!sym(filter), y = unique_loc_count), stat = "identity") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::xlab("country") +
    ggplot2::ylab("Number of locations") +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(paste("Number of locations by country"))
    
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste("Analysis/Figures/histogram_location_count_by_",{filter},".png", sep = ""), plot = p,width=12,height=8,dpi = 300)
  
  return(p)

}

# Function to plot histogram of the number of papers per country or continent
plot_histogram_paper <- function(extracted_data, filter) {
  # Group all composite locations into one country group
  if(filter == "country_cat"){
  extracted_data <- extracted_data %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
      country_cat = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(eff_country,"\\||multi"), " multicountry", eff_country)
    )    
  }
  
  # Summarize number of papers/estimates per country
  paper_count_country <- dplyr::group_by(extracted_data, !!sym(filter)) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(paper_count = length(unique(studykey)))
  
  # Plot histogram of the number of papers/estimates per country/continent
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = paper_count_country) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(ggplot2::aes(x = !!sym(filter), y = paper_count), stat = "identity") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::xlab("country") +
    ggplot2::ylab("Number of Papers") +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(paste("Number of Papers by country"))
  
  # Save the plot
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste("Analysis/Figures/histogram_paper_count_by_",{filter},".png", sep = ""), plot = p,width=12,height=8,dpi = 300)
  
  return(p)
  
}

# Function to plot histogram of the number of estimates per country or continent
plot_histogram_est <- function(extracted_data, filter) {
  # Group all composite locations into one country group
  if(filter == "country_cat"){
  extracted_data <- extracted_data %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
      country_cat = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(eff_country,"\\||multi"), " multicountry", eff_country)
    )    
  }

  # Summarize number of papers/estimates per country
  est_count_country <-  extracted_data %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(!!sym(filter), studykey) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(est_count = dplyr::n()) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(!!sym(filter)) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(paper_weighted_count = mean(est_count))
  
  # Plot histogram of the number of papers/estimates per country/continent
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = est_count_country) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(ggplot2::aes(x = !!sym(filter), y = paper_weighted_count), stat = "identity") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::xlab({filter}) +
    ggplot2::ylab("Number of Average Estimates per Paper") +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(paste("Number of Estimates by ",{filter}))
  
  # Save the plot
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste("Analysis/Figures/histogram_estimates_count_by_",{filter},".png", sep = ""), plot = p,width=12,height=8,dpi = 300)
  
  return(p)
  
}

# Function to plot shapefiles filled by variable, facet by admin level
plot_shapefiles_by_variable <- function(extracted_data, total_shps,country_shps, variable) {

  # Merge extracted_data with shapefiles using 'lctn_pr'
  merged_data <- left_join(total_shps, extracted_data %>% distinct(eff_admin,lctn_pr,!!sym(variable)),by = "lctn_pr") %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(!!sym(variable))==F)
  
  # Plot shapefiles filled by the variable, faceted by admin levels
  if(variable == "average_hdi"){
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = merged_data, aes(fill = !!sym(variable)), color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
      ggplot2::geom_sf(data = country_shps, fill = NA, alpha = 0) + 
      scale_fill_viridis_c() +
      facet_wrap(~eff_admin) +
      theme_bw() +
      ggtitle(paste(variable, "by Admin Levels"))    
  } else{
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = merged_data, aes(fill = !!sym(variable)), color = "black", alpha = 0.5) + 
      ggplot2::geom_sf(data = country_shps, fill = NA, alpha = 0, color = "black") + 
      scale_fill_viridis_d() +
      facet_wrap(~eff_admin) +
      theme_bw() +
      ggtitle(paste(variable, "by Admin Levels"))
  }
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(paste("Analysis/Figures/shapefiles_by_", variable, "_facet_admin_levels.png", sep = ""), plot = p,width=12,height=8,dpi=300)
  print(p)
  return(NULL)
}

# Function to plot histogram of variable vs number of papers/estimates
plot_histogram_variable_vs_paper_count <- function(extracted_data, variable) {
  # Summarize the data by the variable and count number of papers/estimates
  paper_count_variable <- extracted_data %>% 
    group_by(!!sym(variable)) %>%
    summarise(paper_count = length(unique(studykey)))
  
  # Plot histogram of the variable vs the number of papers/estimates
  p <- ggplot(data = paper_count_variable) +
    geom_histogram(aes(x = !!sym(variable), y = paper_count), stat = "identity") +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab(variable) +
    ylab("Number of Papers") +
    ggtitle(stringr::str_glue("Number of papers by ",variable))
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(paste("Analysis/Figures/histogram_", variable, "_vs_paper_count.png", sep = ""), plot = p,width=8,height=6)
  print(p)
  return(NULL)
}


# Function to plot histogram of variable vs number of papers/estimates
plot_histogram_variable_vs_est_count <- function(extracted_data, variable) {

  # Summarize the data by the variable and count number of papers/estimates
  est_count_variable <- extracted_data %>% 
    group_by(!!sym(variable),studykey) %>%
    summarise(est_count = n()) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    group_by(!!sym(variable)) %>%
    summarize(paper_weighted_est_count = mean(est_count))
  
  # Plot histogram of the variable vs the number of papers/estimates
  p <- ggplot(data = est_count_variable) +
    geom_histogram(aes(x = !!sym(variable), y = paper_weighted_est_count), stat = "identity") +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab(variable) +
    ylab("Number of Average Estimates per Paper \n(sum(estiamtes across all paper)/number of papers)") +
    ggtitle(stringr::str_glue("Number of estimates by ",variable))
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(paste("Analysis/Figures/histogram_", variable, "_vs_est_count.png", sep = ""), plot = p, width=8,height=6)
  print(p)
  return(NULL)
}

 # Function to plot histogram of variable vs number of papers/estimates
plot_histogram_variable_vs_effect_paper_count <- function(extracted_data, variable) {
  
  data <- extracted_data %>% 
    dplyr::filter(a_direction != "none") %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(!!sym(variable),a_direction,exp_class) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(
      paper_count = length(unique(studykey))
    )
  
  # Plot histogram of the variable vs the number of papers/estimates
  p <- ggplot(data = data) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = paper_count, x = !!sym(variable),fill=a_direction), stat = "identity") +
    facet_wrap(~ exp_class) +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab(variable) +
    ylab("Number of Papers") +
    ggtitle(stringr::str_glue("Number of papers by exposure class and by ",variable))
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(paste("Analysis/Figures/histogram_", variable, "_vs_paper_count_by_exposure and direction.png", sep = ""), plot = p, width=8,height=6)
  print(p)
  return(NULL)
}


# Function to plot histogram of variable vs number of papers/estimates
plot_histogram_variable_vs_effect_est_count <- function(extracted_data, variable) {
  
  data <- extracted_data %>% 
    dplyr::filter(a_direction != "none") %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(!!sym(variable),a_direction,exp_class,studykey) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(
      est_count = dplyr::n()
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(!!sym(variable),exp_class,a_direction) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(paper_weighted_est_count = mean(est_count))
  
  # Plot histogram of the variable vs the number of papers/estimates
  p <- ggplot(data = data) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = paper_weighted_est_count, x = !!sym(variable),fill=a_direction), stat = "identity") +
    facet_wrap(~ exp_class) +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab(variable) +
    ylab("Number of Average Estimates per Paper") +
    ggtitle(stringr::str_glue("Number of estimates by exposure class and by ",variable))
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(paste("Analysis/Figures/histogram_", variable, "_vs_est_count_by_exposure and direction.png", sep = ""), plot = p, width=8,height=6)
  return(NULL)
}
```
